blockers.sought: Hungarian film production is centred on Budapest: all stage complexes are in Budapest or on the capital's periphery, and working hours for a shoot outside it run from the Budapest sign. (Finding withdrawn 2026-11-01: its only source, FOCAL Production Value, focal.ch/prodvalue/working_conditions/hungary.html, rests on its Hungarian correspondent's report, which names no published primary; it lands again on the National Film Institute's own statement of where stages and production are (the constitution names Budapest as capital, which alone is the capital basis).)

tried.official-register: njt.jog.gov.hu (Nemzeti Jogszabálytár) answers 2026-11-01; no film or stage sector collective agreement or fee rule found by its title search; the Labour Code sets no sector minimum.
